{{Otheruses|Commander}}
'''Junior Commander''' is a line rank within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and one of the four ranks that together encompass the overall position of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. It ranked above [[Senior Lieutenant/Legends|Senior Lieutenant]], and below [[Senior Commander/Legends|Senior Commander]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
